messages:
Nina: Foxtail sent a follow-up: they want a one-page capability matrix, explicit burst billing formula, and confirmation of HSM compatibility (FIPS question). Need packet by COB Tue.
Sam: Use the slim one-pager template from the sales drive. Columns: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Rows: Perf (sustained/burst), Compliance (SOC2/ISO), KMS/HSM, Quantization, Billing.
Diego: Draft perf numbers (conservative): Hosted: 50 QPS sustained @512 tokens (p95 200ms); Dedicated (4xA100 equiv): 300 QPS sustained, absorb 10x bursts up to 10min; Private: depends on infra, provide benchmark ranges.
Nina: Billing snippet proposed: burst_fee = base_rate * excess_multiplier * minutes_billed; excess_multiplier = (burst_QPS/commit_QPS - 1); billing_rate_multiplier = 2.5. Add a numeric example.
Sam: Example to paste: Customer commit=300 QPS. Burst to 1500 QPS for 5 minutes -> excess_multiplier = 4; minutes_billed = 5; burst_fee = base_rate * 4 * 5 * 2.5.
LegalBot: Legal note: say "compatible with FIPS-validated HSMs" rather than claiming FIPS certification. Confirm BYOK and key rotation (default 90 days; configurable in Private). Attach SOC2 snapshot separately.
Diego: BenchRunner started job foxtail-4820001111; ETA 75m for perf logs. Will update matrix p50/p95/p99 when complete.
Nina: Action items: Sam finish one-pager and include the billing example; Diego attach bench logs; Legal attach SOC2 and BYOK wording; I'll assemble and send. Please drop assets in the Foxtail folder by 16:00 PT Monday. :thumbsup:
